page_title: PIS 0-2 INT | Pisa v Inter 30/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Marco Guida is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+4' Idrissa Toure (Pisa) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
90+3' Piotr Zielinski (Inter) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Substitution. Louis Buffon (Pisa) on for Henrik Meister.
90' Alberto Gilardino has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Stefano Moreo (Pisa) replacing M'Bala Nzola.
87' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Carlos Augusto (Inter) replaces Lautaro Martinez.
87' Good chance! Lautaro Martinez (Inter) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored!

83' 0 - 2 Nicolo Barella produces a sweet pass and picks out Lautaro Martinez (Inter) inside the box. He quickly takes a shot which goes into the bottom right corner and leaves the goalkeeper helpless. He makes it 0:2!
83' The resulting set piece from Inter is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
82' Henrik Meister (Pisa) was too forceful with his tackle and Marco Guida interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
80' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Raul Albiol as he is replaced by Lorran (Pisa).
78' Matteo Tramoni (Pisa) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
76' Piotr Zielinski (Inter) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
73' The Pisa players are exchanging some short passes.
71' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Matteo Tramoni (Pisa) comes onto the pitch for Samuele Angori.
71' Alberto Gilardino prepares a substitution. Gabriele Piccinini is replaced by Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris (Pisa).
69' 0 - 1 Goal! Lautaro Martinez (Inter) places a fabulous effort into the top left corner after collecting a brilliant pass inside the box. What a strike that is!
67' We are about to witness a substitution. Yann Bisseck (Inter) is replacing Francesco Acerbi.
67' Cristian Chivu decides to make a substitution. Luis Henrique will be replaced by Andy Diouf (Inter).
67' Substitution. Marcus Thuram makes way for Francesco Pio Esposito (Inter).
65' The game is interrupted as Nicolo Barella (Inter) is flagged offside.
63' M'Bala Nzola (Pisa) lets fly with a decent effort from the edge of the box that flashes just wide of the right post.
61' Raul Albiol (Pisa) sees a yellow card from Marco Guida after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
60' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Pisa comes to nothing.
58' Nicolo Barella (Inter) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
58' Federico Dimarco (Inter) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
57' Inter force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat. Simone Scuffet leaps to intercept the corner kick from Federico Dimarco (Inter).

56' A pass lands at the feet of Nicolo Barella (Inter) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender. Inter will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
56' Henrik Meister (Pisa) blows a huge opportunity! He latches on to a perfect cross from the wing into the penalty area, but sends a bullet header just wide of the left post!
54' Marcus Thuram (Inter) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
53' The resulting corner from Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) is cleared.
52' The linesman raises his flag. M'Bala Nzola (Pisa) is adjudged offside.
52' Pisa take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

52' Idrissa Toure (Pisa) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Pisa.

50' Marcus Thuram (Inter) wastes a great scoring opportunity! He receives a precise lofted cross inside the box and sends a quick low shot towards the middle of the goal. His effort lacks pace and that allows Simone Scuffet to make a comfortable save.
48' Samuele Angori (Pisa) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
47' Piotr Zielinski (Inter) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
46' Marco Guida blows his whistle after Gabriele Piccinini (Pisa) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
46' Petar Sucic goes off the pitch and Piotr Zielinski (Inter) comes on.
46' Referee Marco Guida blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+1' The end of the first half.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Poor challenge! Federico Dimarco (Inter) is penalised for tripping and Marco Guida blows his whistle.
43' Great teamplay by Pisa as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
40' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) creates some space for himself to pick up a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a decent strike which goes a whisker over the crossbar.
39' Pisa work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
38' Inter can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
37' Federico Dimarco (Inter) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. The referee points to the corner flag and Inter will take a corner.
35' Francesco Acerbi (Inter) picks up a yellow card for a foul.
33' A cross is whipped into the centre of the box towards Lautaro Martinez (Inter). He gets a good contact on the ball but heads it high over the bar.
32' Henrik Meister (Pisa) is penalised for a foul. Marco Guida had a clear view and blows his whistle.
31' Dangerous play by Michel Aebischer (Pisa). Marco Guida blows his whistle for a foul.
29' Close! Gabriele Piccinini (Pisa) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the left post.
29' Manuel Akanji (Inter) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.

27' What a chance that is! Lautaro Martinez (Inter) displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross from the free kick, but he steers his header narrowly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Pisa.
26' The foul by Antonio Caracciolo (Pisa) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Marco Guida.
26' Marius Marin (Pisa) commits a foul during an attacking move.

24' Francesco Acerbi (Inter) wastes a great chance as he climbs high around the penalty spot to connect with a cross from the resulting free kick. He produces a header which goes just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Pisa.
23' Raul Albiol (Pisa) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Marco Guida blows his whistle for a foul.
20' Nicolo Barella (Inter) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
17' Federico Dimarco (Inter) plays a through ball inside the box, but it's too strong and Simone Scuffet comes off his line to intercept.
16' The ball is cleared after M'Bala Nzola (Pisa) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.

13' Henrik Meister (Pisa) has the goal in his sights after a good run to the edge of the box, but his weak effort flies well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Inter will have a goal kick.

11' Federico Dimarco (Inter) has the opportunity to threaten the opponent's goal via a free kick on the edge of the box. He hits a fine strike towards the middle of the goal, but Simone Scuffet denies him with a great save.
10' Marius Marin (Pisa) commits a foul after making a slide tackle on his opponent. Inter earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
9' Half-chance! Lautaro Martinez (Inter) plays a pass into the box, but Simone Scuffet reacts well to snuff out the attack.
7' A short pass finds Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter). He spots the keeper off his line and shoots from mid-range, but the ball sails high over the bar.
5' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) is penalised for holding. Marco Guida signals a set piece.
4' Federico Dimarco (Inter) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
3' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
1' An attempted cross from Gabriele Piccinini (Pisa) is cleared.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Inter will kick the game off.
The referee of today's match will be Marco Guida.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
